description: Pre-match head-to-head odds for one sport from The Odds API (v4): each event with start time, teams and each bookmaker's decimal prices, plus the best price per outcome and which bookmaker offers it. Needs the owner's free The Odds API key; uses quota on that key. Related tools on this server, for a different need: sports_pinnacle_odds when you need Pinnacle sportsbook prices from its public guest API; sports_flashscore when you need Flashscore match list for one sport and day: every match. Price: $0.002 per successful call, paid with x402 (USDC on Base, Solana and 10 more networks); failed calls are not charged.

regions.description: Bookmaker region: us, uk, eu or au (default uk)

sport.description: The Odds API sport key, e.g. soccer_epl, basketball_nba, americanfootball_nfl

name: sports_the_odds_api_sports
